title: VKB Offer Entry
description: Frontmatter contract for a Verbose Knowledge Base product entry (products/**/*_README.md). Validate against the parsed YAML frontmatter, not the whole file. Derived from all 157 entries in the bundle as of 2026-09-26; see offer-entry.md for field narrative and known drift.

type.description: Document kind. Product entries are always 'offer'.

title.description: Human-readable product name as TechSoup presents it.

status.description: Whether the offer is currently available.

category.description: Top-level category. Must agree with the entry's directory under products/.

sub_category.description: Narrower grouping. Free text by design today (90 distinct values, many singletons and near-duplicates). Treat as a label, not a key: normalize before grouping or filtering on it.

alias.description: Alternative names the product is known by. May be an empty array.

relations.description: Links from this entry to other product entries. May be an empty array.

reason.description: Prose explanation of why the entry was archived.

allOf.description: ARCHIVED entries must carry the archived block and a reason.

target.description: Directory slug of the related entry, e.g. 'openai'.

type.description: Nature of the relationship. Only 'alternative' is in use.

note.description: Why the relation holds, and any guidance for choosing between the two.

type.description: Nature of the offer. The three 'Built for Nonprofits' variants are singletons and candidates for consolidation.

summary.description: Short plain-language statement of the offer, e.g. '50% Discount' or '$8/user/month'.

badges.description: Display labels shown alongside the product.

standard_tier.description: Commercial tier the offer maps to. Often null.

savings_estimate.description: Estimated value of the offer. Often null.

eligible_audiences.description: Organization types that qualify. Multiple values per entry are normal.

regions.description: Where the offer is available. 'ALL' means unrestricted, not 'every listed region'.

pcs_subject.description: Philanthropy Classification System subject codes, or 'ALL' when the offer is not restricted by subject area.

min_budget.description: Lower budget bound for eligibility. 0 in effectively all entries.

max_budget.description: Upper budget bound. Usually null, meaning no ceiling.

rules.description: Free-text qualifications not captured by the structured fields. Usually null.

notes.description: Deprecated. Duplicates the purpose of 'rules' and appears in exactly one entry (programs/safe_shelter_collaborative). Merge its content into 'rules' and remove; do not add new uses.

provenance.description: What makes an entry citable: when it was last verified, and against what source.

last_audited.description: Date a human last verified this entry against the vendor. Quote it in YAML so it parses as a string.

vendor_url.description: The vendor page the offer terms were read from.

source.description: Origin of the record. 'TechSoup VKB' means authored and audited here; 'products.json (reverse-sync)' means the entry was reconstructed from the downstream feed and its detail is less trustworthy.

archived.description: Present only when status is ARCHIVED. Archived entries are retained rather than deleted so retired offers stay answerable and are not silently re-added.

date.description: Date the offer was archived. Quote it in YAML so it parses as a string.

disposition.description: Why the offer left the catalog.
